# mcprofile

## Overview

mcprofile allows you to calculate signed root deviance profiles for
linear combinations of parameters in a glm. Based on these profiles,
multiplicity adjusted p-values and simultaneous confidence intervals
controlling the family-wise error rate are calculated.

## Installation

``` r

# You can install mcprofile from CRAN by
install.packages("mcprofile")

# Or the development version from GitHub:
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("daniel-gerhard/mcprofile")
```

# Package index

## mcprofile

Constructing profiles for linear combinations of generalised linear
model coefficients

- [`mcprofile()`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/mcprofile.md)
  : Construction of Multiple Contrast Profiles
- [`confint(`*`<mcprofile>`*`)`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/confint.mcprofile.md)
  : Simultaneous Confidence Intervals for Multiple Contrast Profiles
- [`summary(`*`<mcprofile>`*`)`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/summary.mcprofile.md)
  : Multiple Testing of General Hypotheses

## Profile statistics

Change the profiled statistic (default is the signed root deviance)

- [`wald()`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/wald.md)
  : Calculate Wald-Profiles
- [`hoa()`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/hoa.md)
  : Higher order asymptotics using the modified likelihood root

## CI transformation

Functions to transform confidence limits

- [`exp(`*`<mcpCI>`*`)`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/exp.mcpCI.md)
  : exp transformation of Confidence Intervals
- [`expit()`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/expit.mcpCI.md)
  : Inverse logit transformation of Confidence Intervals

## Data

- [`aphidlight`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/aphidlight.md)
  : Aphid attraction at different light intensities
- [`cta`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/cta.md) :
  Cell transformation assay dataset
- [`toxinLD`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/toxinLD.md)
  : Identifying the lethal dose of a crop protection product.

## Misc

- [`orglm.fit()`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/orglm.fit.md)
  : Fitting Order-Restricted Generalized Linear Models
- [`mcprofileControl()`](https://daniel-gerhard.github.io/mcprofile/reference/mcprofileControl.md)
  : mcprofile Control Arguments
